title: Investor's representative built a 1 millinewton thruster in his garage

tellings.quote: What do you mean? I already built one in my garage.

plain: A man representing an investor is said to have built a small thruster in his own garage. It was a device giving a tiny push of about one millinewton, roughly the weight of a grain of sand. Charles Buhler, who comes on the show to talk about building a new kind of propulsion, says that when he described his work, the man told him: "What do you mean? I already built one in my garage." If true, it would mean this kind of thrust can be made outside any big lab.
